# hardcalc – keys and mouse

<!-- Generated by `hardcalc --keymap-markdown` from src/tui/keymap.rs – do not edit by hand. -->

Every function with all ways to trigger it, per input type.
`–` means: not available with this input type. Sequences like `/ R I` go through the
context menu (`/`, then the marked letters).

| Function | Keyboard | Mouse |
|---|---|---|
| Context menu | `/` · `Menu key`¹ · `Shift+F10`² | `right-click` · `Ctrl+click` |
| Menu bar | `F9` | `click ≡ hardcalc` |
| Help | `F1` | `click F1` |
| Save | `F2` · `Ctrl+S` | `click F2` |
| Quit | `F10` · `Ctrl+Q` | `click F10` |
| Command line | `:` | – |
| Open file | `Ctrl+E` · `F9 File Open` | – |
| Edit cell | `Enter` · `F4` | `double-click` |
| Clear cells | `Del` · `Backspace` · `/ E L` | – |
| Copy | `Ctrl+C` · `F5` · `/ E C` | – |
| Paste | `Ctrl+V` · `F6` · `/ E P` | – |
| Undo | `Ctrl+Z` · `/ E U` | – |
| Redo | `Ctrl+Y` · `/ E R` | – |
| Fill down | `Ctrl+D` · `/ R F` | `drag ▪` |
| Fill right | `Ctrl+R` · `/ C F` | – |
| Insert row | `Ins` · `/ R I` | `context menu` |
| Delete rows / columns | `F8` · `/ R D` | `context menu` |
| Sort by column | `F7` · `/ C S` | `click F7` |
| Types tab | `F3` | `click ⚙ types` |
| Pivot view | `Ctrl+P` · `/ T P` | `click ⊞ pivot` |
| Split window | `Ctrl+O` · `/ V S` | – |
| Swap windows | `Ctrl+U` · `/ V W` | – |
| Next table | `Ctrl+PgDn` | `click a tab` |
| Previous table | `Ctrl+PgUp` | `click a tab` |
| Bold on / off | `Ctrl+B` · `/ F B` | – |

¹ only with the kitty keyboard protocol (kitty, WezTerm, foot, Ghostty); not on macOS · ² not on macOS; GNOME Terminal (VTE) intercepts it
